name: job-search-assistant
description: Plan and track a job search with local workspace persistence, application preparation, referrals, and approved browser workflows.

publication.release_notes: 0.1.2 adds a publicly accessible, versioned privacy policy URL. Local workspace persistence, workflows, and the 16-column tracker schema are unchanged.

interface.longDescription:
Organize your job search in a local workspace you control. Track roles, review next steps, research openings, prepare truthful resume and application materials, and coordinate referrals and follow-ups. Return in a new chat to continue from your saved tracker and progress.

Designed for Codex and ChatGPT Work sessions with access to your local files. Browser workflows also require supported browser tools and sign-in to the relevant service. LinkedIn Jobs is the primary discovery source; Indeed is optional. Review and approve uploads, messages, application submissions, and public profile changes.

This plugin contains skills and templates, with no publisher-operated server or background service. Your working files persist outside the installed plugin. Local storage does not mean offline processing: information read by the assistant is processed through OpenAI and any services you choose to use. Cloud-only sessions cannot load your computer's workspace without local computer access. No cross-device sync or job-placement guarantee is provided.

Independent project by Farzam Hejazi; not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI, LinkedIn, Indeed, or employers.
defaultPrompt: Help me set up a local workspace for my job search.
Review my job tracker and recommend my next steps.
Continue my job search from saved progress.
